parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh-CN** (default): Chinese.
- **en-US**: English.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter information. You can specify key-value pairs to filter the query results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.
This example queries the zones available for NAT gateway resources in the UAE (Dubai) region.
